name: Homeless
overview: Scripture reveals a compassionate call to care for those who are poor, cast out, or without shelter, emphasizing that believers should strengthen and relieve them as an expression of godly love (Leviticus 25:35, Isaiah 58:7). The Lord values acts of mercy toward the needy, promising to repay those who give generously to the poor (Proverbs 19:17). Jesus Himself experienced homelessness, having no place to lay His head, which underscores the humility and sacrifice of the Son of Man (Matthew 8:20, Luke 9:58). Believers are encouraged to prioritize eternal treasures by giving alms and forsaking earthly possessions, reflecting a heart aligned with God's kingdom rather than earthly security (Luke 12:33).
